Real CDMs and reference 2D-Pc values from NASA CARA (Conjunction Assessment Risk Analysis),
https://github.com/nasa/CARA_Analysis_Tools/tree/master/DataFiles/PcTestCaseCDMs (NASA Open Source Agreement).
cara_pc.csv = columns Conjunction_ID, HBR_m, Pc2D_NoAdj, Pc2D, Comment of CARA_PcMethod_Test_Conjunctions.xlsx (results dated 2025-07-03).
Used by tests/pc-cara.test.ts.
